harness: probe service (tools/stallfloor/probe.py): frozen kernel families, every thread of every launch judged against a host-computed checksum
what: 6 requests of probe.py 34 (eighth build), all kind ord, six grids (1, 8, 9, 12 and 16 warps per SM, and 2 CTAs of 9 warps per SM), 40 repetitions, no word in front: a SET of producers of one thread in flight under ONE predicate - N,gN,gN (an unguarded `LDG.E.CONSTANT` and two guarded ones) and N,i,gN,gN (with a `SHFL.IDX` behind the first) - every member on the same write barrier with the yield flag, the one wait on a word that reads no member, and THE FIRST READER WORD behind the wait is `ISETP.GE.AND P3` of a guarded load's register: a member read INTO ANOTHER PREDICATE ("preader": "set"; `SEL R, R4, R5, P3` joins the fold). s_ngg_p_cc_l, s_ngg_p_ff_l, s_nigg_p_cc_l, s_nigg_p_ff_l: with "pthird": "lane" - the third write of the one predicate is `ISETP.NE.AND P0, PT, R31, RZ, PT` from the lane, one cycle in front of the waiting word; the guards are a bit of the iteration counter (cc) or false in every lane (ff). s_ngg_p_cc: the reference without the lane write. s_ngg_p_cc_ew: the control - the reference's text with the wait moved behind the reader words (it must not be right). The members 1 and 4 cycles apart (the control: 4)

conditions.gpu: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition
conditions.card_state: a Server Edition card (this model takes no clock offset); the probe alone, no power limit

provenance.dep_table_commit: 53c8224c tools/stallfloor/probe.py 27 and 28: a wait under another predicate (kind gp), the readers of a CS2UR result, a

classes.good: the intended values in all 256 iterations
classes.stale: raw / ord: the consumer took the register's previous content in all 256
classes.late: war: the store took the rewritten register in all 256
classes.overtake: war: the read-back saw the slot before the store in all 256

requests.pair: a SET of 3 producers of one thread in flight (version 23: R0-R79), oldest first: LDG.E.CONSTANT @!P0 LDG.E.CONSTANT @!P0 LDG.E.CONSTANT; ONE wait of the reader (the thread's own line, one base register; every load on the SAME write barrier) [version 28 - TWO PREDICATES on one write barrier: P0 = a bit of (iteration counter x 0x9e3779b1) (true where the bit is 0) - bit 31 for the first pair, the next lower bit for every further pair; P2 = a bit of (iteration counter x 0x9e3779b1) (true where the bit is 0) - bit 20; EVERY GUARD IS WRITTEN NEGATED (version 31, pneg: `@!Pn`): a load executes where its predicate is FALSE; both are written at the top of every iteration by ISETP.GE.AND, P0 again 13 cycles in front of every further `@P0 LDG.E.128`; the first reader word stands 2 cycles behind the last arming; THE ONE WAIT STANDS ON A WORD THAT READS NO MEMBER, one cycle in front of the first reader word (third build)]; version 34: every producer also sets the READ barrier of the set's number; version 34: the first reader word, on the ONE wait, is `ISETP.GE.AND P3` of the first register read - a member into a PREDICATE; `SEL R, R4, R5, P3` joins the fold; version 34, second build: BOTH guarded `LDG.E.CONSTANT` stand under ONE predicate - P0 is written AGAIN between them (`ISETP.GE.AND P0` right behind the first, 13 cycles in front of the second; letter c: from the next lower bit of the counter's hash - the two loads execute under different values of P0); version 34, seventh build: THE THIRD WRITE OF THE ONE PREDICATE IS ANOTHER WORD FROM ANOTHER CONDITION - `ISETP.NE.AND P0, PT, R31, RZ, PT` (R31 = SR_TID.X & 0x1f, written at the top of the iteration by `LOP3.LUT R31, R0, 0x1f, RZ, 0xc0, !PT`), one cycle in front of the word that carries the wait, while both guarded loads fly [the swept instruction carries the YIELD flag]
